label.ingredients_text: Soy Wey Protein Isolate, Vegetable Glyciate, Vegetable Com Fiber, Erun Piette, Erythritol, Cocoa Butter, Almond Butter, Sunflower Flavors, Sucralose, Salt, Steviol Glycides
label.summary: This product has some redeeming qualities, but it is noticeably processed.
label.recommended_action: Okay occasionally, but not ideal as a staple.
concerns: Uses protein isolates rather than mostly intact foods.

flag_explanations.title: Artificial Additives
flag_explanations.explanation: Artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives are synthetic compounds your body doesn't need. Some (like BHT, BHA, certain dyes) have been linked to health concerns in research. Simpler ingredient lists avoid these.
flag_explanations.look_for: Products using natural preservatives like vitamin E (tocopherols) or citric acid

flag_explanations.title: Protein Isolates
flag_explanations.explanation: Protein isolates are heavily processed extractions — the protein is stripped from the whole food. While not harmful, they indicate a highly engineered product rather than real food. Whole-food protein sources are preferable.
flag_explanations.look_for: Whole eggs, Greek yogurt, nuts, legumes, real meat for protein
